name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.me.view.BindBankCardActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens this form when the user adds or edits a bank card. It collects the account holder, bank, card number, and registered phone, then verifies the change.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from adding or changing the bank card used for payouts.
